raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 도시 산책 프로젝트를 소개해줘. 천천히 걸을 때 익숙한 거리에서 새롭게 보이는 빛과 흔적을 매력적으로 표현해줘. 서로 확연히 다른 스타일의 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 첫 두 장은 16:9 가로, 나머지 세 장은 2:3 세로로 만들어줘. 좋은 구도와 읽기 순서는 공유해도 돼. 아래 Title과 본문만 각각 한 번씩 넣고, Title은 바로 알아볼 수 있게, 본문은 휴대폰에서 편하게 이어 읽게 해줘. 새 부제, eyebrow, 날짜, 장소, footer, 로고, QR이나 다른 문구를 만들지 말아줘. 큰 고딕 글씨와 단색 바탕에 작은 이미지나 질감만 붙이는 포스터는 제외해줘.

Title: 걷다가 발견한 것들
본문: 익숙한 길을 천천히 걸으며 빛, 소리, 사람의 흔적을 만납니다. 스쳐 지나간 풍경에서 새로운 이야기를 발견해보세요.

procedure_errors: editorial: trace contains a failed turn/error

procedure.method: Fresh independent review in this session, with no spawn, fork, resume or peer review. Read the pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, addendum and all five pinned native-evidence manifests; did not follow their unlisted embedded paths. The packet declares no source assets or protected layouts, so the corresponding receipts are explicitly empty. Opened and visually inspected each exact poster with tools.view_image(detail='original'), forwarding the returned image at original detail, in member order M1, M2, M3, M4, M5 and, within each, native then usage720 then thumbnail320. All fifteen opens completed before the first actual copy-reading/transcription stage, any judgment or score. Native views were 1672×941 for M1/M2 and 1024×1536 for M3/M4/M5; usage views were 720×405 and 720×1080 respectively; thumbnails were 320×180 and 213×320. Hash/byte and PNG-header checks corroborated the bindings and sizes but are not substituted for the actual visual opens. First readings used the already displayed native/usage pixels after the full opening sequence; no ambiguity-triggered revisit was needed. No source identity, omitted copy, maker intent, event or runtime session ID was inferred. The seven ratings and whole-set comparison below are my own pixel-based judgments.

evidence.location: upper-left title and four-line body
evidence.observation: The two-line dark serif title is the immediate typographic anchor. The full body follows in four readable sans-serif lines on the illuminated paving; both supplied strings appear once. No legible additional copy role, logo, QR or watermark is visible.

evidence.location: paving diagonals and right-hand glass
evidence.observation: The curb and shadows remain scene-defining at small size. The photograph occupies the composition rather than serving as a small ornament on a solid headline field. Its natural depth and public street reflections distinguish it from M2's graphic marks, M3's drawn wear, M4's painted night and M5's harsh printed surface.

evidence.location: large drain at upper-right and cracked paving through lower field
evidence.observation: Recognizable elongated drain slots, paving seams, erosion and the diagonal light band form substantive nonglyph content across the canvas; the print speckle is subordinate to those objects.

evidence.location: right drain and crossing sunlit pavement
evidence.observation: The drain's dark intervals and the light exposing worn joints reveal an everyday piece of street infrastructure at meaningful scale, supporting attention to overlooked traces.

content_form.location: grate, eroded seams and light band
content_form.observation: The downward crop invites noticing the familiar ground underfoot. Worn stone and a drain create concrete urban traces, while a strong strip of light reframes those ordinary details.

hierarchy.observation: The short one-line title and four-line body form a compact entry, then the large black slots and diagonal light lead across the image.
The title remains a clear anchor even at its smaller apparent scale; the grate continues to register as the primary image shape.

typography.location: heavy serif title and sans-serif body
typography.observation: The Korean title has a cohesive heavy serif voice, with clear counters and word gaps; the body is structurally consistent and punctuation is intact.
All body lines remain comfortable to read and the background speckling does not materially cross or erase the glyphs.

space.location: lit upper-left pavement, grate crop and diagonal lower light
space.observation: The copy sits in a coherent illuminated patch, balanced by the large grate and by the diagonal across the lower field. The cropped grate implies continuation beyond the frame.

image_material.location: rough cream/teal pavement and near-black drain slots
image_material.observation: The granular print treatment and hard value separation describe an abrasive street surface; clear grate and joint shapes keep the texture attached to real objects rather than a decorative noise field.

emotion_control.location: dark rough paving and cream diagonal
emotion_control.observation: The sharp light and coarse surface create concentrated, gritty curiosity about what is normally overlooked. The cream copy area gives the dense ground enough relief for the invitation to remain accessible.

ai_slop.location: grate outline and connected paving seams
ai_slop.observation: The slotted grate is recognizable and the major seams join into an intelligible ground surface. Repeated speckle is extensive but follows the print treatment rather than introducing arbitrary ornaments or contradictory objects.

residuals: The granular treatment gives several materials a similar roughness, reducing local tonal nuance; the drain and paving remain identifiable.
The heavier title differentiates its voice, though it retains the set's familiar upper-left title/body organization.
Native 1024×1536 is mathematically exact 2:3; thumbnail 213×320 rounds the short edge.

evidence.location: street panorama and mirrored glass
evidence.observation: The warm photographic public street, deep reflections and long pavement shadows give M1 an observational daylight identity. Compared with M3's tight drawn threshold, it uses believable street depth and actual-looking reflected activity rather than isolated wear.

evidence.location: yellow/navy perspective and red prints
evidence.observation: M2's saturated planar contrast, monumental gothic line and distressed sole route form the most outward and graphic identity. Its simplified light/shadow geometry and walking marks differ in construction, emotional energy and type voice from all four surface scenes.

evidence.location: pale cracked wall, door handle and step
evidence.observation: M3's fine contour drawing, light washes, blue/cream relationship and serif body create quiet close observation of use and age. It shares a legible upper-left reading order with M1/M4, but its object intimacy, surface drawing and daylight restraint are distinct from their photographic public depth and painted night warmth.

evidence.location: dark wall, lit window and golden pavement
evidence.observation: M4's heavy brush marks, cool-dark/amber relationship and luminous occupied window give an intimate nocturnal identity. The emotional center is interior life reflecting outward, unlike M3's weathered threshold or M5's abrasive infrastructure; its similar two-line title layout does not erase that difference.

evidence.location: overhead drain, rough print and diagonal cream band
evidence.observation: M5 has hard printed value separation, coarse teal/cream/black surface, a downward crop and heavier one-line serif anchor. Compared with M3, the object, viewing angle, tonal force, glyph weight and emotional abrasion change together; this is more than adding a filter to the same doorway composition.

residuals: All five use a left-aligned title followed immediately by a four-line body; M1/M3/M4 also have closely related serif headline voices. This shared functional order is allowed, but limits the set's typographic breadth.

M1/M3/M4/M5 all study street surfaces or building edges. Their differing scene relationships, image construction, light/contrast and emotional effects achieve five recognizable identities, while the common observational family keeps diversity at 4 rather than exceptional 5.
The five members and this single editorial review are fully assessed. No claim is made about the two other critics, their scores, the all-three gate or unseen requests.

procedure.method: Independent fresh review without spawning, resuming or forking. Read the pinned packet, literal case, rubric, review rules, compact addendum and method/adapter. Verified exact input bytes and PNG headers; read all five listed native-evidence manifests without opening their unlisted embedded paths. The packet declares no source assets and no protected layouts, so both receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Actually opened and visually inspected, through tools.view_image with detail original and functions image output, M1 native then usage720 then thumbnail320, followed by M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same three-view order. These fifteen actual successful opens were all completed before the first copy-reading/transcription stage, judgment or score. Subsequently read the retained native/usage images for each member and each copy entry in packet order. No OCR, replacement assets, crops, image changes or additional image opens/revisits were used. Successful pin checks were not treated as semantic viewing. Session identity is unobservable here and is left null. Usage views are 720x405 for M1/M2 and 720x1080 for M3/M4/M5; thumbnails are 320x180 and 213x320 respectively, with aspect preserved to integer raster rounding and no upsampling.

evidence.observation: Pavement depth, long shadows, reflective glazing and the raised sill remain substantive even at thumbnail size; they occupy and organize the composition beyond the copy block.

evidence.observation: The worn paving catches newly visible sunlight and the glass contains pedestrians and street activity, giving concrete urban light and human traces to the walking project.

content_form.location: foreground stone slabs and right reflected walkers
content_form.observation: The low view makes ordinary pavement texture and passing people worth looking at; diagonal light/shadow supplies the specific discovery promised by the copy.

hierarchy.location: upper-left title, body and right storefront

The title remains an identifiable anchor while the street scene remains substantial.

typography.observation: Serif-like Korean title forms have coherent stroke contrast and proportions; the simpler body has intact glyphs, punctuation and word spaces without crowding.
The approximately 17-pixel body scale is readable with open leading; the long second line ends before the storefront step and keeps a visible gap.

space.location: left margins and diagonal sill
space.observation: Title and body share a deliberate left edge and generous outer margin. The diagonal sill balances the occupied upper-left corner with the large lower pavement area; that area expresses distance and light rather than an unused solid field.

image_material.location: stone sill, paving joints and vertical glass edges
image_material.observation: The curb/sill perspective, stone pores and specular reflections remain coherent across the scene. Foreground detail and softened distant street depth support a convincing photographed material language.

emotion_control.location: gold light and long foreground shadows
emotion_control.observation: The warm grazing light and ordinary passing figures create an inviting, attentive walk without adding decorative sentimental symbols. The restrained dark type allows the light to carry the mood.

ai_slop.observation: No extra copy, floating icons or contradictory foreground joints are visible. Distant cars and walkers are softened and locally compressed in the glass, but the main storefront/paving construction remains coherent.

residuals: Distant pedestrians and cars in the right reflection have less local definition than the foreground stone; the project depends on their presence rather than readable facial or vehicle detail.
The second body line approaches the diagonal step more closely than the shorter lines, although the gap and contrast remain readable at usage720.
Warm sunlight on a street is a familiar photographic motif; the observed strength is the low paving/sill/reflection relationship, not exceptional conceptual novelty.

evidence.location: right and lower diagonal paving
evidence.observation: Two large red sole impressions, one entering through the lower crop, sit on a perspective paving grid. The visual remains prominent alongside the title rather than shrinking to an ornament.

evidence.location: footprint route and top/right shadow geometry
evidence.observation: Visible sole traces lead from the foreground into the street plane, while angular yellow/blue light divisions make an ordinary walking surface newly graphic and noticeable.

content_form.location: two red shoe impressions and receding grid
content_form.observation: Stepping traces and a receding paved route communicate walking directly; the structural shadow bars turn overlooked urban light into a graphic pattern rather than relying on generic decoration.

hierarchy.location: title and supporting paragraph on yellow
hierarchy.observation: The one-line title reads first through scale and contrast. The four body lines follow at one left edge, then the red marks lead diagonally across the image.
Both the title and the nonglyph route retain strong distinct silhouettes.

typography.observation: Heavy Korean gothic glyphs remain complete and visually consistent. Word gaps separate the title units and the body preserves readable spacing and punctuation despite its weight.
The body remains comfortable at phone-use width, with clear leading and full-word line endings rather than abrupt character breaks.

space.location: irregular yellow wedge and blue foreground
space.observation: The sloping yellow boundary contains the copy naturally and gives the second body line room. The cropped foreground sole and intact right sole balance the dense upper-left text while keeping the blue pavement active.

image_material.location: red sole treads and white paving seams
image_material.observation: Distressed blue cuts inside the red prints provide a consistent stamped surface treatment. Clean white seams and substantial shadow bars establish legible spatial geometry; the simplified planes work together rather than pretending to photographic realism.

emotion_control.observation: The sharp primary contrast gives the act of noticing a lively public-poster energy. Restricting the palette and attaching the red accents to actual walking marks keeps the energetic effect controlled and content-specific.

ai_slop.location: paving lines, shadow bars and distressed marks
ai_slop.observation: The motifs have observable roles as seams, shadows and shoe traces; there are no gratuitous badges, logos or repeated filler text. Some scuff fragments are loose and noisy, but they remain bounded inside the two prints.

residuals: The urban setting is deliberately reduced to paving and structural shadow bars; it has less site-specific architectural detail than M1/M3/M4/M5.
The fine distressed cuts in the sole impressions partly collapse at thumbnail320, although the footprints and their direction remain clear.
The vivid graphic energy communicates walking traces more strongly than a quiet tempo; it remains appropriate to the open brief without requiring a muted mood.

content_form.location: diagonal light boundary and large drainage grate

typography.observation: The stout serif-related title has intact, consistent forms and distinct word spaces. The simpler body remains lighter, evenly led and punctuated.

image_material.location: drain openings, cracked rim and surrounding concrete
image_material.observation: The dark slots and pale rims preserve clear drainage geometry; broken chips and coarse marks establish a consistent reduced print treatment. emotion_control.location: deep black slots and worn teal/cream paving
emotion_control.observation: The severe contrast and abrasive grain make an ordinary street detail feel tactile and searching. The controlled diagonal illumination adds discovery without unrelated expressive ornaments.

content_form.location: foreground stone slabs and right reflected walkers
content_form.observation: The low view makes ordinary pavement texture and passing people worth looking at; diagonal light/shadow supplies the specific discovery promised by the copy.

hierarchy.location: upper-left title, body and right storefront
hierarchy.observation: The two-line title leads, the smaller four-line paragraph follows directly, and the sill then takes the eye into the image. The bright pavement provides sufficient calm around all copy.

typography.observation: Serif-like Korean title forms have coherent stroke contrast and proportions; the simpler body has intact glyphs, punctuation and word spaces without crowding.
The approximately 17-pixel body scale is readable with open leading; the long second line ends before the storefront step and keeps a visible gap.

space.location: left margins and diagonal sill
space.observation: Title and body share a deliberate left edge and generous outer margin. The diagonal sill balances the occupied upper-left corner with the large lower pavement area; that area expresses distance and light rather than an unused solid field.

image_material.location: stone sill, paving joints and vertical glass edges
image_material.observation: The curb/sill perspective, stone pores and specular reflections remain coherent across the scene. Foreground detail and softened distant street depth support a convincing photographed material language.

emotion_control.location: gold light and long foreground shadows
emotion_control.observation: The warm grazing light and ordinary passing figures create an inviting, attentive walk without adding decorative sentimental symbols. The restrained dark type allows the light to carry the mood.

ai_slop.observation: No extra copy, floating icons or contradictory foreground joints are visible. Distant cars and walkers are softened and locally compressed in the glass, but the main storefront/paving construction remains coherent.

residuals: Distant pedestrians and cars in the right reflection have less local definition than the foreground stone; the project depends on their presence rather than readable facial or vehicle detail.
The second body line approaches the diagonal step more closely than the shorter lines, although the gap and contrast remain readable at usage720.
Warm sunlight on a street is a familiar photographic motif; the observed strength is the low paving/sill/reflection relationship, not exceptional conceptual novelty.

evidence.location: right and lower diagonal paving
evidence.observation: Two large red sole impressions, one entering through the lower crop, sit on a perspective paving grid. The visual remains prominent alongside the title rather than shrinking to an ornament.

evidence.location: footprint route and top/right shadow geometry
evidence.observation: Visible sole traces lead from the foreground into the street plane, while angular yellow/blue light divisions make an ordinary walking surface newly graphic and noticeable.

content_form.location: two red shoe impressions and receding grid
content_form.observation: Stepping traces and a receding paved route communicate walking directly; the structural shadow bars turn overlooked urban light into a graphic pattern rather than relying on generic decoration.

hierarchy.location: title and supporting paragraph on yellow
hierarchy.observation: The one-line title reads first through scale and contrast. The four body lines follow at one left edge, then the red marks lead diagonally across the image.
Both the title and the nonglyph route retain strong distinct silhouettes.

typography.observation: Heavy Korean gothic glyphs remain complete and visually consistent. Word gaps separate the title units and the body preserves readable spacing and punctuation despite its weight.
The body remains comfortable at phone-use width, with clear leading and full-word line endings rather than abrupt character breaks.

space.location: irregular yellow wedge and blue foreground
space.observation: The sloping yellow boundary contains the copy naturally and gives the second body line room. The cropped foreground sole and intact right sole balance the dense upper-left text while keeping the blue pavement active.

image_material.location: red sole treads and white paving seams
image_material.observation: Distressed blue cuts inside the red prints provide a consistent stamped surface treatment. Clean white seams and substantial shadow bars establish legible spatial geometry; the simplified planes work together rather than pretending to photographic realism.

emotion_control.observation: The sharp primary contrast gives the act of noticing a lively public-poster energy. Restricting the palette and attaching the red accents to actual walking marks keeps the energetic effect controlled and content-specific.

ai_slop.location: paving lines, shadow bars and distressed marks
ai_slop.observation: The motifs have observable roles as seams, shadows and shoe traces; there are no gratuitous badges, logos or repeated filler text. Some scuff fragments are loose and noisy, but they remain bounded inside the two prints.

residuals: The urban setting is deliberately reduced to paving and structural shadow bars; it has less site-specific architectural detail than M1/M3/M4/M5.
The fine distressed cuts in the sole impressions partly collapse at thumbnail320, although the footprints and their direction remain clear.
The vivid graphic energy communicates walking traces more strongly than a quiet tempo; it remains appropriate to the open brief without requiring a muted mood.
